messages:
jordan: Heads-up 1 opened a small migration PR for Console observability docs to switch examples from legacy `X-Cloud-Trace-Context` to W3C `traceparent`. Also updating the cost/latency widget example to reflect new metric keys. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/451

docs-bot: Pull request opened by @jordan 1 automated checks: linkcheck found 1 outdated dashboard URL, code-lint flagged TS snippet line length.

nina: I saw the PR. We recently renamed a couple metric keys in backend: `token_cost` -> `token_unit_cost`, and grouping key is now `api_route`. Make sure examples use those.

oliver: For SDK snippets I'd prefer showing header injection per-request rather than client-wide so it's clear how to attach traces to specific calls. Example I propose (TS):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-ai/sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })

// attach a W3C traceparent to one request
const res = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-chat-7b',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ping' }],
  headers: { traceparent: '00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01' }
})
console.log(res.text)
```

jordan: good snippet. Nina, could you also add a 1-line sampling note? e.g., "Default sampling is 1% for hosted traces; contact infra to increase." Also include a short troubleshooting tip about proxies stripping trace headers.

nina: will do. Also fixed the broken dashboard URL in the JSON example (v2 schema). I replaced `/dashboards/v1/schema` with `/dashboards/v2/schema` and updated the example payload.

frank: quick suggestion for the docs: show the minimal widget JSON for cost + latency so users can copy-paste. Proposed fragment:
```json
{
  "widget_type": "cost_breakdown",
  "metrics": ["token_unit_cost","latency_ms_p50","latency_ms_p95"],
  "group_by": ["api_route","model"],
  "time_range": "7d"
}
```

oliver: tiny nit: in the prose use `token_unit_cost` when explaining billing to avoid confusion. Also add a migration checklist at the top mapping old keys -> new keys.

docs-bot: Linkcheck now passes for the updated URL. Build preview ready but linter still flags a long line in the TS snippet.

nina: formatted the TS snippet, force-pushed. Added sampling note and proxy troubleshooting line: "If traces are missing, ensure intermediate proxies are not removing `traceparent` headers or that sampling is enabled."

jordan: can someone confirm if the Console enforces a 32-hex `trace-id` in `traceparent`? we should call out the format.

frank: yes, follow W3C trace-context: version|trace-id(32 hex)|parent-id(16 hex)|flags. I'll add a link to the spec and a one-liner example. Link: https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/

jordan: action items: (1) nina - finalize Python + TS snippets, sampling note, proxy troubleshooting (2) frank - add widget JSON and migration checklist (3) oliver - quick editorial pass on wording and merge once lints clear. Target: EOD. Ping me if CI blocks merge. :rocket: 

oliver: happy to merge once docs-bot is green. If lint blocks, I can run the formatter in CI.

jordan: thanks all! I'll leave a merge hold until we confirm CI.
